title: University Outcomes

dataSources.name: compared.edu.au (QILT-derived: Graduate Outcomes Survey, Student Experience Survey)
dataSources.vintage: 2025 GOS collection (Graduate Employment, Graduate Satisfaction); 2024 SES collection (Student Experience)

notes: GOS/SES are annual collections released on different cycles, so the two metric families can sit a year apart; the dashboard shows the latest published year for each, with no historical trend yet. The 2025 GOS changed its labour-force definition to align with ABS, so employment metrics are not strictly comparable with earlier years.
